transcript: Clerk: Ain't technology swell? Remember how we used to black out all the sensitive information from the official documents by hand?
Clerk: In last three months we have been able to black out the sensitive parts by a simple computer program!
Lt. Katz: So… In last three months everybody have been able to read all the sensitive parts by a simple PDF-reader.

fail_fact.title: Is redacted data really redacted?
text: On December 2025, the US Department of Justice (DOJ) recently published a very large amount of files related to the infamous Jeffrey Epstein scandal. Readers quickly realized that the redacted data could be read by just simple copy-pasting the redacted text to an external editor. The legal fallout is yet to be realized, court battles are just beginning.
When you want to share something that has parts that need to stay secret, make sure to use the right tools – and test the outcome before publishing.
